description:
rein-klaʊd brings the Rein operator console to iPhone and iPad while your harness and tools keep running on hardware you control.

Connect to your private Rein gateway, open a named agent, and continue its durable conversation. Streaming replies clearly identify operator input, agent responses, and tool execution. Actions that require approval under your Rein policy open a native allow-or-deny prompt. A run continues on the host if the phone locks or changes networks.

The interface carries Rein's field-guide design into a native mobile layout with Light and Night themes, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver support, and optional vintage computer sounds.

rein-klaʊd does not provide a hosted AI service or collect your conversations. It connects directly to a compatible Rein server configured by you.
promotionalText: Carry your durable Rein sessions between desk, phone, and tablet while execution stays on your own host.
